en: A black‑and‑white vintage postcard view of a river flowing through a rocky gorge with a small town in the background. Several bridges cross the river, including a metal truss bridge further back and a smaller bridge in the foreground. On the distant hill a domed building rises above other houses and factory chimneys. Printed text at the top left reads "Uddevalla – Bäveån".
